title: Find the Pairs
brief: Flip six cards two at a time; matching colours stay open, a mismatch costs one of six tries. Find all three pairs to win.

title: Colour Sorter
brief: An orb of a random colour appears; tap the basket of the same colour within 4 seconds. Sort 10 orbs to win, 3 mistakes lose.

title: Odd One Out
brief: Four tiles, one turns pink each round; tap it. 8 right answers win, 3 wrong taps lose.

title: Lamp Pattern
brief: Three lamps flash a 4-step pattern; repeat it by tapping. A wrong tap replays the whole game, the full pattern wins.

title: Gridlock
brief: Tap blocks to push them out of the way and drive the red car to the green exit within 18 moves.

title: Count and Tap
brief: Three levels: tap plus to make exactly the target number of dots, then press check. A wrong count restarts the level, a timer ends the run.

title: Safe Code
brief: A 4-digit code shows for 3 seconds then hides; enter it on three keys from memory. A wrong key resets, the right code opens the safe.

title: Tint Tiles
brief: Each tap cycles a tile red, green, blue; make all four tiles green within 10 taps.

title: Switch Memory
brief: Lamps show an on/off pattern for 3 seconds, then go dark; set three switches to match and press enter. A wrong setting restarts.

title: Stop at Fifteen
brief: Roll a die to add to a total and stop between 12 and 15 to win; going over 15 or rolling too many times loses.
